technical debt.

Adam Whelchel had already built an accounting firm from scratch to $1.5m of annual revenue.

Then there's the tax angle.

Adam was looking at a hefty 2026 tax bill of roughly $95,000. That offset was substantial enough to reduce his tax bill by more than his deposit to buy the business.
